commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak 37% and benchmark indices violating key short-term moving averages under heavy institutional distribution, Stan Weinstein's stage discipline mandates extreme caution. When general market pressure mounts, roughly three out of four stocks track the broader indices lower. William O'Neil's market-direction rule dictates preserving cash and avoiding aggressive commitments until a verified follow-through day emerges. While defensive pockets and select capital goods show Stage 2 resilience, progressive exposure rules require keeping position sizes tight, honoring stop-losses without hesitation, and restricting fresh focus strictly to candidates showing confirmed earnings acceleration and superior relative strength.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above its rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, approaching a 20-session pivot at 104.09 on 1.63x volume with RSI 57. However, the consolidation lacks tight VCP symmetry, displaying loose, erratic swings rather than systematic institutional absorption.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals violate CANSLIM standards. Sales plunged 56.3% YoY while quarterly profit dropped 25.6%. Low return on equity (3.1%), sub-6% ROCE, razor-thin operating margins, and declining multi-year revenue trends show an absence of institutional-grade business momentum.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breakdown below the 97.24 scanner stop or 50-day SMA invalidates the pivot; severe top-line contraction warns of structural weakness.

ACE.technical: Maintains an intact Stage 2 structure above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. A double-bottom base with a 12.8% cup and 5.6% handle shows constructive upper-half supply absorption, supported by positive MACD momentum.
ACE.fundamental: Infrastructure demand drove 20.5% operational revenue growth and 22.3% PAT growth to ₹119.5 crore. Domestic crane market share exceeds 60% and ROCE tops 25%. However, quarterly EPS growth has decelerated from 31% to 22%, capping the CANSLIM rating.
ACE.risk: Violation of the 1,190.67 stop or neckline failure voids the pattern; decelerating profit momentum warrants strict defense.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Consolidating near its 20-session pivot at 1,861.56, comfortably above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Trading volume expanded to 1.49x average with RSI 53, reflecting orderly digestion within an established primary uptrend.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Operational revenue rose 18.6% YoY to ₹10,821 crore, fueled by an 80% surge in international port revenues. Nonetheless, domestic volume growth slowed to 2% and quarterly PAT growth decelerated sharply to 9.2%, falling short of CANSLIM's 25% EPS benchmark.
ADANIPORTS.risk: A breach of the 1,774.89 scanner stop or loss of the 50-day average terminates the setup, requiring capital protection.

AEGISLOG.technical: A true market leader exhibiting high relative strength against index weakness. The stock executed a textbook pullback to its rising 21-EMA near all-time highs, completing a three-candle bullish reversal that confirms strong institutional accumulation off dynamic support.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals. Q1 PAT skyrocketed 212% YoY to ₹545 crore on 37.1% top-line growth, powered by 91% volume expansion in gas distribution. Normalized EBITDA expanded 184% to ₹727 crore with prudent 0.6x gearing and extensive ongoing terminal expansions.
AEGISLOG.risk: A close below the 1,383.09 stop or breach of the 50-day SMA negates the pullback thesis; cut losses immediately.

ALBERTDAVD.technical: Carving out a double-bottom base above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Price is testing pivot resistance at 932.78 on 1.54x volume expansion with RSI 57, reflecting a constructive Stage 1-to-2 breakout attempt.
ALBERTDAVD.fundamental: Delivered a sharp operational turnaround in Q1, with PAT surging 303% YoY to ₹32.0 crore and revenue rising 43.6% to ₹101.3 crore. Debt is minimal with a 0.07x debt/equity ratio, though micro-cap liquidity and past margin variance dictate prudent exposure.
ALBERTDAVD.risk: A drop below the 878.59 stop or failure at the double-bottom neckline aborts the recovery setup; exit promptly.

ALICON.technical: Staged a powerful 20-day high breakout on an extraordinary 26.65x average volume surge, clearing 782.78 with MACD firmly positive. The price trades well above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, though the large range bar verges on near-term extension.
ALICON.fundamental: Consolidated Q1 revenue grew 37.9% YoY to ₹578 crore, accompanied by an accelerating 23.0% YoY PAT recovery (+44.2% QoQ). Working capital cycle improved sharply from 24.8 to 11.6 days, supporting expansion, though ROE remains modest at 7.4%.
ALICON.risk: A reversal below the 704.98 stop or failure to hold the breakout pivot flags institutional distribution; exit swiftly.
